title: Release notes on the first start after an upgrade (/whats-new)
behavior: After upgrading the package, the first interactive pi start shows what changed since the version you last ran, once; later starts stay silent, and /whats-new shows those notes again on demand.
hint: Start pi twice in a row: the first start shows "pi-toolkits updated X → Y", the second does not. `/whats-new` re-shows the notes, `/whats-new all` lists every bundled release, `/whats-new off` silences the startup notice.

title: Permission parser: approval-log false positives 52 → 16
behavior: Routine read-only commands — grep with quoted regexes, literal for-loops over files, env pipelines, docker ps and curl with -w — no longer stop for an approval, while unresolved outputs, sudo and arbitrary code still do.
hint: In a session with /ask-perm on: `grep -n '\s*$' `, `for f in a b; do grep -n x "$f"; done`, `env | grep PI_`, `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://localhost/` and `docker ps` should run without a dialog; `echo x > "$UNKNOWN"` and `sudo …` still ask.

title: Startup-only release notes and permission safety review fixes
behavior: An upgrade shows its release notes once on the next interactive start without adding any slash command, and shell variables or unresolved redirects that cannot be judged safely now keep asking instead of risking an allow.
hint: Start pi twice after an upgrade: the first shows the notes and the second is silent; there is no /whats-new command. With permission enabled, conditional/reassigned shell variables and unresolved redirects should still ask.

title: 发版等待：registry 改走 HTTP 探测、进度分阶段、排队卡死的 run 自动补发
behavior: 发版时等待 CI 的那一段现在会分阶段打印进度（run 未出现 / 排队 / 运行中 / CI 已绿、等 npm 传播），并且卡在排队、迟迟不开始的 run 会自动补发一次 workflow_dispatch，不再需要人工 gh workflow run 救援。
hint: 下次发版时看这一段输出：应依次出现「workflow run 还没出现 / CI queued / CI in_progress / CI 已绿…等 registry 传播」，每行带 t=Ns。想看补发，把 PI_RELEASE_RESCUE_QUEUE_MS 设成比正常排队更小的值（如 3000）再发一版，会看到「⚠ run … 排队 Xs 仍未开始 —— 补发 workflow_dispatch」与「↳ 已接管新的 run …」。

title: quit-guard: 三层退出兜底 + arm 级心跳 watchdog 线程，修复 exit 路径死锁导致进程不死
behavior: 崔总退出 pi 时，即使宿主退出路径死锁（包括把事件循环一起卡死的深挂），quit-guard 也会在超时后由独立线程强制结束进程并写报告，终端可靠地回到 shell 提示符，不再出现关窗才能逃离的冻结画面。
hint: 装一个在 process.on("exit") 里 Atomics.wait 死锁的探针扩展，/quit 后 ~10s 进程应被杀且 tmux pane 回到 shell 提示符；对照组 /quit-guard off 时同一探针下进程永挂。

title: ask-init: framework parity, safe auto-refresh, and phase guards
behavior: Running `/ask-init` again now tells you whether the project's framework text matches the installed version, repairs missing or stale framework-owned files when safe, and says explicitly when nothing needs changing; ask/plan/UAT phases can no longer be stacked, and a hand-edited AGENTS.md example can no longer be mistaken for the managed workflow block.
hint: In a framework project, run `/ask-init` twice: the second run should report framework files current without a model turn. Run `/ask-init check` and look for the W-FW/I-FW/W-PATH codes. In a project without the framework, `/ask-uat` and `record_change` refuse with the missing list; `/ask` and `/ask-review` stay usable.

title: Review fixes for ask-init parity and phase integration
behavior: After the third-party review, framework refreshes now distinguish real hand edits from missing anchors, dry runs no longer tell the operator to reload, wrong-type framework paths are rejected, missing AGENTS.md is reported explicitly, and planning in a linked worktree checks the framework in the main checkout.
hint: Run /ask-init refresh --dry-run and verify there is no /reload reminder; create a linked worktree and start /ask-plan to verify it sees the main checkout's framework.

title: ask-spec: rename the browser review and rebuild the review page
behavior: The browser review is now `/ask-spec` (with `/ask-plan` still working), and its page shows a warm two-column layout with a revision/annotation rail and a bottom bar that puts the review controls on the left and the total note count in the middle.
hint: Run `/ask-spec <topic>` in a project, write and submit a spec, then open the review page: the header says Spec review, the right rail lists revision stats and clickable notes, and the footer has Only changed / Global notes on the left with the note count centered.

title: ask-spec review: fix rename compatibility and history errors
behavior: The spec review now clears legacy phase markers, keeps legacy histories visible during partial migrations, and no longer labels older revisions as latest.
hint: Switch to an older revision: the history summary shows only its block count, not “latest revision”. Legacy-store and marker behavior is covered by regression tests.

title: Remove plannotator extension and pen.dev/pencil CLI from the host
behavior: The operator now sees no plannotator in pi's package list, no `pen`/`pencil` commands in the shell, and only the paintress MCP server in pi, while the VS Code pencil extension keeps working untouched.
hint: `pi list | grep -i plannotator` prints nothing; in a fresh fish shell `type pen pencil` reports not found; `pi` still starts and its MCP tools list shows paintress only; the VS Code pencil extension (WSL window) still connects.

title: pi 1.6.0 host compatibility migration
behavior: After upgrading pi to 1.6.0 the plugin still loads and every feature works, and the README now states only the tested range (`pi >= 0.99.0`, verified through 1.6.0) instead of explaining our internal window/probe policy.
hint: Run `pnpm check:compat` and read the verdict block (window 1.3.0–1.6.0, probe 1.2–0.99, floor 0.99.0); open README.md and confirm the Requirements line and the contributor "Host compatibility" bullet mention only the floor and the verified range.

title: keep 会话暂存：/keep-quit、/keep-load、/keep-drop
behavior: 用 /keep-quit 退出后会话进入待办，下次启动的一行提示和 /keep-load 列表能把它重新打开；已载入的会话置灰但仍可选，/keep-drop 或列表里的 ctrl+r 把做完的移出。
hint: 1) 在任意有内容的会话里 `/keep-quit 测试备注`，退出后重开 pi：应看到 `1 not loaded · /keep-load`。2) `/keep-load`：↑↓ 选、enter 载入、`ctrl+r` 移出；再进一次列表，刚载入的那行应变灰但仍可选中。3) `/keep-drop` 后该会话从待办消失。

title: keep review: rebuild, persistence and resume-note error fixes
behavior: Rebuilding the keep backlog no longer brings back sessions the operator explicitly dropped, and a failed resume-note write no longer makes an open session look unloaded.
hint: Keep a session, drop it, then run /keep-load rebuild: it must stay dropped. For the error path, unit tests simulate a failed resume-note write and verify the loaded marker survives.

title: Bare /ask-spec toggles out of spec mode
behavior: While a spec review is active, running /ask-spec without arguments now exits the review instead of only warning that one is already open.
hint: Run /ask-spec topic, then run /ask-spec with no arguments: the review closes and the notification says spec mode is off. Run /ask-spec without arguments again to start a fresh default-topic review.

title: ask-spec: reopen a new review window after feedback
behavior: After sending feedback on a spec, the next revision the agent submits now opens a new review window on a fresh server instead of printing a dead URL.
hint: Run /ask-spec <topic>, submit a spec, send feedback on the page, and let the agent revise and submit v2: a new browser window should open on a new port, and the history drawer should still list v1. `/ask-spec open` after a decision should also bring back a live page.

title: /ask-talk 回复批注、评审页标题索引与回到顶部
behavior: 崔总跑完一轮对话后输入 /ask-talk，浏览器里把 agent 最后一条回复当文档逐段读，点任意段落写一条批注、底部输入一句话，按 Continue 后回到 pi 只发回「批注 + 那句话」继续对话；评审页右侧还多了一列小横杠，指过去展开标题索引、点标题直接跳转，右栏滚出屏幕后右下角出现「回到顶部」。
hint: 1) 在任意会话里跑 /ask-talk，浏览器应打开逐块可批注的页面；2) 点一块「+ Add note」写一句、底部输入框写一句，按 Continue，回到 pi 应收到「引用块 + 批注 + 你的话」的消息且不含回复原文；3) 评审页右侧横杠悬停展开标题索引，点标题跳转；把右栏滚出屏幕后右下角出现「回到顶部」。

title: ask-talk 与标题索引的第三方评审修复
behavior: 崔总在新一轮回答后复用 /ask-talk 页面时会看到真正的新回复，Continue 也会带上尚未点 Save 的批注；连续点击标题只高亮最新目标，标题和正文没有空行时也不会丢内容或漏掉索引。
hint: 1) 连答两轮后在原页面再跑 /ask-talk，应显示新回复且旧批注清空；2) 在正文块写批注但不点 Save，直接 Continue，会话应收到该批注；3) 用「## A」紧跟正文再紧跟「## B」的回复打开页面，两个标题都应进索引，正文完整显示。

title: ask-talk: open every run, session title, shared port pool, outline/composer/back-to-top fixes
behavior: Running `/ask-talk` now pops the review window every time (same reply included), the page is titled with the session name so parallel sessions are distinguishable, all review pages share ports 3401–3499, the right-hand index shows its first and last bars and scrolls when short, "Back to top" lines up with the footer, and the composer keeps a full line of text when blurred.
hint: Run `/ask-talk` twice in a row (second run must open a window), check the h1/tab title is the session name, open several pages to see ports 3401, 3402…; on a short window hover-free the strip and confirm the first/last bar are visible; blur the composer with one line and confirm the text is not clipped.

title: Review pages move to the 7600–7699 pool; compat matrix green on 1.3.0–1.6.1
behavior: Review pages now live on ports 7600–7699 instead of 3401, so WSL and Windows port forwarders no longer take the page's port out from under it; the compatibility matrix now covers pi 1.6.1 and every supported version passes the full suite.
hint: Open two review pages (`/ask-spec` + `/ask-talk`) and check their URLs are 7600/7601; `pnpm check:compat` reproduces the green window 1.3.0–1.6.1.

title: Review fixes: dev proxies and docs follow the 7600–7699 pool
behavior: Developers running either Vite review UI now reach the live review server on port 7600, and the documentation consistently describes the shared 7600–7699 pool.
hint: Start a live review server on 7600, run `pnpm ui:dev`, and confirm `/api/state` is proxied successfully.

title: ask-spec and ask-talk: confirmed manual close without replying
behavior: Both ask-spec and ask-talk pages now have a Close button beside the language switch; after confirmation it closes the review server and tries to close the tab without sending anything to the agent, and it still works as a closed-state fallback after reload makes the server unreachable.
hint: On either page, click Close beside the language switch: Cancel must do nothing; confirm must close the review server without a decision/message. Repeat after `/reload`: the page must show its closed/unreachable state rather than reconnecting forever.

title: Release tail self-check: bound every child process and say what it is waiting for
behavior: When you run `pnpm release`, the tail self-check now prints which check is running (npm / provenance / remote tag / release) with a live `t=Ns` timer, and finishes within a few minutes even on a dead network path instead of sitting silently on a step header.
hint: Run `pnpm release patch` on a normal network: the four checks each print a `… npm / provenance / remote tag` line with `（t=Ns）`. To see the failure path, unplug the network after the tag push — the step ends with `❌ remote tag 无法确认（git 超时）` instead of hanging.

title: Remove quit-guard (the quit watchdog and its force-exit)
behavior: There is no `/quit-guard` command and no 8-second force-exit any more: if pi's shutdown hangs, it stays hung with the process still alive, so the hang can be inspected (or killed by hand) instead of being silently killed by the extension.
hint: Start pi and type `/quit-guard`: it is no longer a registered command. `~/.pi/agent/pi-toolkits-quit-guard.json` is no longer read, and a hung `/quit` now stays hung (kill it yourself).

title: Release is done when the workflow run is green — drop the npm/provenance tail checks
behavior: When you run `pnpm release`, it now stops at the green workflow run and prints tag / run / Release plus a link to the npm package page — it no longer waits for npm to show the version or its provenance attestation, and a red run is reported with the run's conclusion.
hint: `pnpm release patch --dry-run` shows the new plan: step 6 says a green run is enough, step 8 is a summary with no npm check. A real release ends with the three-line `完成` block (tag / CI run / release).

title: Outline popup: rows keep their height instead of being squashed by the flex list
behavior: When you hover the contents strip on the review page, the popup's rows now keep their real height — text sits centered in each row instead of spilling out of the bottom, the list scrolls for long documents, and the row for the section you are reading is already in view when the panel opens.
hint: Open any review page (spec or talk) with many headings, hover the right-edge strip: rows are evenly spaced with 7px around the text, no line is clipped by the next row's highlight. In a long document, scroll to a late section first — the panel opens with that red row visible.

title: Third-party review fixes: isolate talk refreshes and diagnose release probe failures
behavior: When a reply-annotation page refreshes, drafts from the previous reply no longer leak into the new one, and when a release cannot verify a remote tag it now reports an unknown probe with recovery steps instead of claiming the tag is absent or printing undefined.
hint: For talk, type a composer draft and refresh to a new reply within 300ms: neither the browser nor a reopened page should carry the old draft. For release, simulate an SSH failure during the previous-tag check: it must stop with 'probe failed or timed out' and a git ls-remote recovery command, never 'remote tag absent' or 'undefined'.

title: Bound the publish command's own child processes, not only its GitHub helpers
behavior: When you run `pnpm release`, its own git commands (including the branch and tag pushes) now stop with an error after a bounded delay instead of hanging forever on a dead connection, and the other direct gate commands have an overall time limit too.
hint: Simulate a git command that never returns during `pnpm release patch --dry-run`: the direct git call is killed after about 20 seconds instead of sleeping indefinitely. Normal releases keep their existing output and flow.

title: release: check every release material before running any gate
behavior: When the release materials are incomplete — uncommitted changes, an empty `## Unreleased`, a missing `CHANGELOG.md` in `files`, a tag that already exists for the target version, or an unfinished previous release — `pnpm release` now stops in a few seconds, before any test runs, and lists every gap at once with the action to take, instead of failing after the two-minute gate with a single hint.
hint:
1. 在干净树上 `pnpm release patch --dry-run` —— 应看到五项物料全 ✅ 且列出「提升 ## Unreleased」。
2. 改一个文件让它变脏、或把 `## Unreleased` 的 bullet 删掉，再跑 `pnpm release patch`（不加 --dry-run）—— 应在几秒内以 ❌ 中止，并给出 `⇒` 下一步。

title: Drop the /third-review and /ask-plan compatibility aliases
behavior: Typing `/third-review` or `/ask-plan` no longer runs anything — the old spellings are gone from the command list, and an autostart config still using them is skipped with a warning instead of being sent to the model as chat; `/ask-review` and `/ask-spec` are the only entry points.
hint:
1. 交互式启动后输入 `/` 看命令列表——里面应只有 `/ask-review`、`/ask-spec`，没有 `/third-review`、`/ask-plan`。
2. 在 `.pi/autostart.toml` 里临时写一条 `/third-review`，启动会话：应看到「未注册命令、已跳过」的告警，且不会把这句话发给模型。

title: Default a spec note to "suggest" and move it to the left-most pill
behavior: On the spec review page, clicking "Add note" now opens with "suggest" already selected, sitting left-most next to "must change" and "question", instead of starting on "must change".
hint: Run `/ask-spec` on any spec, click "+ Add note" on a block: the left-most pill is the highlighted "suggest". Save it as "must change" and add another note — the editor is back on "suggest".
